releases.summary: Move complete-status sync preview out of rfi_system_sync/preview.rs into preview/complete_status.rs; behavior unchanged.
Split ParsedPdf object access, inspection, and graph hashing out of pdf/parsed.rs into submodules; behavior unchanged.
Split OOXML XML parsing/serialization and cell-reference helpers out of xml.rs into xml/parse.rs and xml/cell_reference.rs; behavior unchanged.
Split OOXML relationship validation and target path normalization out of relationships.rs into submodules; behavior unchanged.
Move Follow Up editor metadata and projection-budget helpers out of rfi_follow_up/scan.rs into scan/editor.rs; behavior unchanged.
Extract duplicate source-row merge from scan_source_records into merge_source_record; behavior unchanged.
Split mapping_details into named helpers in rfi_follow_up/source/mapping_details.rs; detail text unchanged.
Split orientation checkpoint finish and plan-file steps out of pdf_orientation/support.rs into submodules; behavior unchanged.
Move plan table choice-label lookup into editorChoiceLabel in editorRules.ts with unit tests; behavior unchanged.
Move outlook_reply_draft inline unit tests into outlook_reply_draft/tests.rs; behavior unchanged.
Split RFI code parsing and clause routing out of rfi_follow_up/source.rs into submodules; behavior unchanged.
Move S5 journal state accessors and prepare/cancel transitions out of s5.rs into s5_accessors.rs; behavior unchanged.
Move the per-file approved-plan loop of preview_indexed into plan_file with PlanTotals; behavior unchanged.
Extract the per-file checkpoint finish step from preview_indexed into finish_checkpointed_file with CheckpointInputs; behavior unchanged.
Extracted per-PDF fingerprint, hash, and checkpoint-or-inspect step from preview_indexed into prepare_pdf.
Extracted PDF page-rotation step construction from preview_indexed into rotation_step helper.
Extracted cached orientation page rebuild from preview_indexed into cached_page_results helper.
Extracted per-file orientation page approval from preview_indexed into pure approve_file_pages helper.
Moved PDF orientation path and rotation helpers into operations/pdf_orientation/support.rs.
Moved BackendRouter select_paths and reveal_path into backend/paths.rs.
Moved RFI follow-up record placement (RecordIndex and place_record) from classify.rs into classify/placement.rs.
Extracted remaining browser-demo preview branches (PDF orientation, log add) into named helpers.
Split browser-demo previewOperation branches into named preview helpers in lib/mockPlanHandlers.ts.
Moved browser-demo reviseOperation from lib/mockPlanHandlers.ts into lib/mockReviseHandler.ts.
Moved demoPrintOperation from frontend lib/demoOperations.ts into lib/demoPrintOperation.ts.
Moved platform unit tests from platform/mod.rs into platform/tests.rs.
Moved Windows print submission classification helpers out of platform/mod.rs into platform/windows_submission.rs.
Moved follow-up apply step out of fs_ops/apply.rs into fs_ops/apply/follow_up_apply.rs.
Moved RFI system sync apply step out of fs_ops/apply.rs into fs_ops/apply/rfi_system_apply.rs.
Moved plan editor column-width state and resize setter into useEditorColumnWidths.
Changed: OCR direction scoring (DirectionScore and its selection and summary helpers) moved from ocr/orientation.rs into ocr/orientation/scoring.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Changed: PDF object serialization moved from pdf/parser.rs to pdf/serialize.rs, and stream decoding (decode_stream, apply_predictor) moved into pdf/codec.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Changed: the BackendMethod roster and its authorization table moved from backend.rs into backend/method.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Changed: the support-bundle sanitizer (sanitize_value and its key, path and error-code helpers) moved from diagnostics.rs into diagnostics/sanitize.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Changed: the RFI Log column layout tables (Layout, RfiStatusColumns, layout, status_columns) moved from rfi_log.rs into rfi_log/column_layout.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Changed: RFI Follow Up signed-by placement (place_signed_record, refresh_signed_slots, signed_slot_rows) moved from classify.rs into classify/signed.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Docs: ROADMAP.md no longer calls the selected-message MSG archive implemented. It has no operator route yet, so the roadmap item now adds that route before certification.
Docs: KNOWN_ISSUES.md now says the Outlook archive scaffolding is marked allow(dead_code), not reported by the compiler. Corrected after checking the source.
Changed: the operation form merges preset, previous-values and field edits through one mergeValues helper, and the batch-print RFI finder parameters are a named constant. No behavior change.
Changed: the Notice, EmptyState and Centered primitives moved from components/ui.tsx to components/feedback.tsx. Importers updated. No rendering or behavior change.
Chore: removed unused imports in lib/bridge.ts, helpers.tsx and two App test files, and the unused sharedBridge variable in lib/mockBridge.ts. No behavior change.
Fixed: docs/TRACEABILITY.md cited App.test.tsx, which the App suite split replaced with App.*.test.tsx files. The matrix now names the files that exist.

Fixed: the browser demo mock implements settings/presets, savePreset and deletePreset per operation. Batch print no longer shows a 'Mock method not implemented' error. Desktop builds call the Rust backend and are unchanged.
Accessibility: the sign-in password visibility toggle gets an explicit aria-label alongside its title, so its accessible name no longer depends on the tooltip fallback. Visual behavior is unchanged.
Maintainability: remove a duplicated comment line above the paused replica-automation and replica-plan cache helpers in native.rs and native/plan.rs. No code change.
Accuracy: docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md no longer lists the frontend bundle size advisory as open. The screens are already split on demand; the entry now records the measured sizes. No code change.
Maintainability: the saved-parameters resume card moves out of OperationScreen.tsx into PreviousValuesCard.tsx, matching PrintQueueResumeCard. Markup and behavior are unchanged.

Maintainability: the schema parameter visibility rule lives in one helper, isParamVisible in lib/operationValues.ts. OperationScreen and SchemaField use it instead of duplicating the visibleWhen check. Behavior is unchanged; a unit test covers the helper.

Maintainability: the ActionBar layout component moves out of components/ui.tsx into components/ActionBar.tsx, and its five consumers import it from there. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the signed-stage navigator and signed warning review summary move out of PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/PlanSignedSummaries.tsx, and PlanView imports them from there. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Tests: the review screen suite now covers a failed undo. It runs preview, apply and undo with a rejecting undo bridge and checks that the error shows and the result stays for retry. The test fails without the 1.36.114 fix and passes with it.
Fix: a failed undo on the review screen now shows its error. Before, the undo call had no error handling, so a rejected undo left an unhandled promise rejection and no message on screen.

Maintainability: the BusyState progress panel moves out of components/ui.tsx into components/BusyState.tsx. Its test is renamed to BusyState.test.tsx, and its five consumers import it from the new file. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the interrupted print-queue resume card moves out of OperationScreen.tsx into screens/PrintQueueResumeCard.tsx, and four unused imports are removed. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the PlanWarnings list moves out of PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/PlanWarnings.tsx. PlanView and the localization test import it from the new file. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the Modal dialog moves out of components/ui.tsx into components/Modal.tsx, and its test moves with it. The two modal consumers (plan/SignedPageComparison.tsx and screens/HistoryScreen.tsx) import it from the new file. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Fix: the review screen's 'will replace an existing file' warning looked up the action by file path instead of selection id, so it never appeared. It now reads the selection id. The three batch buttons share one helper, and a regression test covers the warning.

Correctness and maintainability: SchemaField.tsx dispatches to MultiFileField and PathField in SchemaFieldKinds.tsx. Both call useState, which SchemaField previously called after conditional early returns, breaking React's hook-order rule. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the SettingsGroup and ChoiceGrid layout helpers move out of SettingsScreen.tsx into screens/SettingsParts.tsx. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the WorkbookChangePreview table moves out of PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/WorkbookChangePreview.tsx, and PlanView imports it from there. Markup and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.
Maintainability: the OutlookReplyPreview panel moves out of PlanView.tsx into plan/OutlookReplyPreview.tsx. Markup and plan rendering are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the per-cell editor rendering in EditablePlanTable.tsx moves into plan/PlanCell.tsx, which takes the cell's value, choices, suggestions and change handler as props. Markup and editing behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite (289) pass.

Maintainability: the AppFrame navigation shell and Splash move out of App.tsx into AppFrame.tsx, and unused imports are removed from both files. Markup and routing are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite pass.

Maintainability: the batch-print RFI document finder section moves out of OperationScreen.tsx into RfiPrintFinderPanel.tsx, and the reveal-destination lookup becomes a named helper. Markup, labels and behavior are unchanged; typecheck and the frontend suite (289) pass.

Maintainability: classify_workbooks_full moves the source-missing and unknown-status manual-review row into source_issue_row and the summary warnings into projection_warnings. Logic is unchanged; clippy and lib tests (542) pass.

Maintainability: operations/rfi_file_group.rs (831 lines) moves filename and content code detection into rfi_file_group/analysis.rs and destination and copy step construction into rfi_file_group/steps.rs. Preview and revise stay in the parent. Logic is unchanged; clippy and lib tests (542) pass.

Maintainability: cap_fs.rs (820 lines) moves the file security snapshot and secured-create code into cap_fs/security.rs and the retained-storage accounting into cap_fs/retained_storage.rs. Logic is unchanged; clippy and lib tests (542) pass.

Maintainability: undo.rs (823 lines) is split by concern: step dispatch and undo planning in undo/steps.rs, quarantine recovery and hash checks in undo/quarantine.rs, and capability root and path validation in undo/roots.rs. Logic is unchanged; clippy and lib tests (542) pass.
Maintainability: the PathGrantStore methods in paths.rs move into issuing, authorization, and revocation modules under paths/. Method logic is unchanged; clippy and lib tests (542) pass.
Maintainability: the 2,845-line ooxml test module is split by concern into seven files with shared helpers in tests.rs. Tests are unchanged; the lib suite (542) and clippy pass.
Maintainability: the 4,180-line excel export-supervisor test module is split by concern into eight files with shared fixtures in mod.rs. Tests are unchanged; the lib suite (542) and clippy pass.
Maintainability: the 2,683-line App.test.tsx is split by area into seven test files with shared helpers in test/appTestSupport.ts. All 55 tests are kept unchanged; the full suite passes.

Maintainability: the signed-by slot change-marking pass and row-emitting pass in classify_workbooks_full moved into refresh_signed_slots and signed_slot_rows. Logic and row order are unchanged; clippy and rfi_follow_up tests pass.

Maintainability: the routed-signed-target loop in classify_workbooks_full moved into place_signed_record, sharing RecordIndex with place_record. Loop logic is unchanged; clippy and rfi_follow_up tests pass.

Maintainability: the per-record placement loop in classify_workbooks_full moved into place_record, which takes a RecordIndex of shared inputs. Loop logic is unchanged; clippy and rfi_follow_up tests pass.

Maintainability: the signed-unmapped manual-review row in classify_workbooks_full now uses manual_review_row, with its signed status labels set after. Output is identical; rfi_follow_up tests and clippy pass.
Maintainability: the slot-pruning pass in classify_workbooks_full moved into prune_slot_codes with the same logic and order. Clippy and the full lib test suite pass.

Maintainability: the second manual-review row in classify_workbooks_full (no mapping) now uses manual_review_row too, then sets its default route target columns. Output is identical; rfi_follow_up tests and clippy pass.

Maintainability: the unknown-route manual-review row in classify_workbooks_full now uses the existing manual_review_row helper instead of an inline FollowUpRow literal. Output is identical; rfi_follow_up tests and clippy pass.
Accessibility: the multiline cell textarea in the plan table now has an accessible name (its column label), matching the single-line inputs in the same table. Frontend tests and build pass.
Fix: the shared Button component now defaults to type="button", so a Button placed inside a form no longer submits it. Callers can still pass type="submit" explicitly. Frontend tests and build pass.

Maintainability: the slot index construction used by classify_workbooks_full (by-code and by-sheet-column indexes over non-signed slots) moved into index_slots with named key aliases. No behavior change; rfi_follow_up tests and clippy pass.

Maintainability: classify_workbooks_full now delegates slot construction (build_slots) and the mass-deletion evidence check (deletion_evidence) to named helpers. No behavior change; rfi_follow_up tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the rfi.group_files operation definition moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/file_group.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the stage-signed-pages, normalize-PDF-orientation and fast-cover-scan operation definitions moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/signed_scans.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the four RFI follow-up, system-sync, complete-status-sync and publish-status operation definitions moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/rfi_sync.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the rfi-log operation definition moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/rfi_log.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the rfi batch-print operation definition moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/print_batch.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: ExcelExportPipeline and its orchestration (staging, worker wait, cleanup, and quarantine handling) moved out of platform/excel.rs into platform/excel/pipeline.rs. No behavior change; 66 Excel tests, print-queue tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the Excel worker runtime (ExcelWorkerRuntime and ExcelWorkerHandle traits, WorkerPoll and WorkerJoin, and the thread-backed implementations) moved out of platform/excel.rs into platform/excel/worker.rs. No behavior change; 66 Excel tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the rfi.generate_concrete_documents operation definition moved out of the operation_registry function into registry/concrete_documents.rs. No behavior change; registry tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the PrintService type and its methods moved out of print_queue.rs into print_queue/service.rs. No behavior change; print queue tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the undo, recover-pending and failed-restore methods of FilesystemAuthority moved out of fs_ops/follow_up.rs into fs_ops/follow_up/undo.rs. No behavior change; fs_ops tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the coverage helpers for signed-destination and CIV matching (SignedDestinationCoverage, signed_destination_coverage, civ_tag_coverage, distinct CIV area and zone-area row counting, mec_context_coverage) moved out of rfi_follow_up/routing.rs into rfi_follow_up/routing/coverage.rs. No behavior change; routing and classify tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the XML cell-patching helpers for concrete documents (CIV-010 numeric and row patching, numeric and text cell setters, row shifting) moved out of concrete_documents.rs into concrete_documents/cells.rs. No behavior change; concrete-document tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the Outlook draft validation and journal helpers moved out of outlook_reply_draft.rs into outlook_reply_draft/helpers.rs. No behavior change; Outlook tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the replica-publish snapshot and hashing helpers moved out of operations/replica_publish.rs into replica_publish/snapshot.rs. No behavior change; replica tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the XML attribute read, bounded-read, and write helpers moved out of ooxml/xml.rs into ooxml/xml/attributes.rs. No behavior change; ooxml tests (105) and clippy pass.

Modularity: the free path-guard helpers (lexical escape checks, ancestor resolution, revalidation, link detection, grant expiry) moved out of paths.rs into paths/filesystem.rs. No behavior change; path tests and clippy pass.

Modularity: the Unix extended-attribute capture and replay helpers moved out of cap_fs.rs into cap_fs/unix_xattrs.rs. No behavior change; Unix-only module is cfg-gated; cap_fs tests and clippy pass. Windows build not verified here.

Modularity: batch-print row building (plan_from_rows, job_from_row, NormalizedSettings, and the workbook row readers) moved out of operations/batch_print.rs into batch_print/rows.rs. No behavior change; batch-print and print tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: directory scanning for PDF orientation moved out of operations/pdf_orientation.rs into pdf_orientation/directory.rs. No behavior change; orientation tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the per-PDF scan loop and its state types moved out of operations/process_scans.rs into process_scans/scan_pdf.rs. No behavior change; process-scans tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the PrintJob type and its validating deserializer moved out of print_queue.rs into print_queue/job.rs. No behavior change; print_queue tests and clippy pass.
Modularity: the staged-workbook and exported-PDF types moved out of platform/excel.rs into platform/excel/staged.rs. No behavior change; excel tests pass.
Accuracy: renamed a backend timestamp helper whose name suggested a chrono clock; it returns unix seconds. No behavior change.
Robustness: two plain buttons in the home and review screens now declare type="button", so they cannot submit an enclosing form. No visible or behavior change.
Mobile: on touch screens, the mobile navigation items and the switch controls get a larger invisible tap area (about 44 px), without changing how they look. Desktop layout is unchanged.
Robustness: eight streaming copy and hash buffers moved from stack arrays to heap buffers, so the 1 MiB buffer no longer risks overflowing a Windows main-thread stack. No behavior change.
Efficiency: eight library call sites no longer clone values that are moved afterward. No behavior change.
Test coverage: the editable plan table's group-select button is now tested for its accessible name, visible count, and selection behavior.
Accessibility: the group-select button in the editable plan table now has an accessible name, so a screen reader no longer announces only its row count.
Accessibility: the duplicate and remove-duplicate row buttons in the RFI editor now have explicit accessible names, matching the move buttons beside them.
Maintainability: the RFI log's static regex patterns use expect with a message instead of unwrap, so a failed pattern names its cause. No behavior change.

Fix: the Windows directory listing reads its records from an 8-byte-aligned buffer, closing the alignment concern recorded in KNOWN_ISSUES. Not compiled or run on Windows here; the native check remains outstanding.

Documentation: every remaining unsafe block in the Windows modules (directory handles, COM and Excel/Outlook, Windows PDF, startup registry, file replace) now has a SAFETY note. One real concern found and recorded in KNOWN_ISSUES: the Windows directory listing reads records from a byte buffer without an alignment guarantee. No behavior change.
Documentation: every unsafe call in the Windows printing module now has a SAFETY note (printer enumeration, device contexts, GDI+ image loading, job observation). Comments only; no behavior change.
Test coverage: the preset helpers (which settings a preset remembers, and the plain-language message for a failed preset write) are exported and unit-tested. No app behavior change.
Test coverage: the batch-print RFI number chooser now has unit tests for default checked state, per-number toggling, and select-all and select-none. No app behavior change.
Test coverage: the batch-print RFI results panel now has unit tests for its select-by-request toggle and the ambiguous-request announcement. No app behavior change.
Test coverage: the compact date picker (clamps the day when the month changes, reports only complete dates) and the busy-stage cancel control now have unit tests. No app behavior change.
Documentation: the remaining unsafe calls in the clipboard, PDF OCR bridge, PDF publish, journal lock, and file-rename code now have SAFETY notes. No behavior change.
Documentation: every unsafe call in the file-security code (cap_fs.rs: ownership, mode, and extended-attribute calls) now has a SAFETY note. No behavior change.
Documentation: every unsafe call in the Unix directory-handle layer now has a SAFETY note stating why it is sound. No behavior change.

Accessible names for toggles: the Settings switches and the per-user Admin access and admin switches now have explicit names. Admin switches include the user name, so identical toggles on different rows can be told apart.

Heading structure: every screen now has exactly one level-1 heading. The top bar title is a paragraph by default, so it no longer adds a blank or duplicate H1. Settings and the workflow screen keep their bar title as the H1 because nothing else names them. Appearance is unchanged.
Accessibility of progress: the run progress bar is a labelled progressbar with its values when the total is known, and the phase text (preparing, scanning, and so on) is announced as a status.
Keyboard and screen-reader focus after Apply: when the result appears, focus moves to it, the same as after a preview. Before, focus fell back to the top of the page.
Keyboard and screen-reader focus: after a preview succeeds, focus moves to the preview itself. Before, the Önizle button disappeared and focus fell back to the top of the page.

Turkish copy consistency: error, warning and help sentences now use the formal plural (seçin, girin, açın, kontrol edin) the rest of the app uses. Button labels keep their short form. The admin hint no longer switches to informal wording.
Review screen copy: the Turkish help text now uses the formal form used elsewhere in the app, and the batch-action bar has its own label instead of repeating the help sentence.

Required-field errors now mark the field they belong to: the input gets aria-invalid and a stronger border, so screen readers and sighted users see which field to fill. The message above the form is unchanged.

Accessibility: option groups (Settings theme and language, and each Review row action) now announce the selected option and name their group, so screen readers no longer hear identical unlabelled choices.
Accessibility: each folder or file Browse button now says which field it fills (for example, Gözat: Gelen dosyalar klasörü), so screen readers no longer announce identical buttons.
Internal cleanup: the path-grant unit tests move out of paths.rs into their own test files. Behavior unchanged.
Internal cleanup: the backend router tests move out of backend.rs into backend/tests.rs. Behavior unchanged.
Internal cleanup: the follow-up classifier dispatch and sheet/schema helpers move into their own module. Behavior unchanged.
Internal cleanup: the three PDF file-effect steps (first-page replace, page rotate, page extract) move into their own module. Behavior unchanged.
Internal cleanup: print failure classification (failure kinds, retry rules, submission outcome) moves out of print_queue.rs into its own module. Behavior unchanged.
Internal cleanup: the path and output helpers of the scan-processing workflow move into their own module. Behavior unchanged.
Docs accuracy: the known-issues note about the Outlook archive described a preview function that was already removed. It now describes the remaining scaffolding.
Internal cleanup: three identical file-name helpers (display_name) become one shared function in naming.rs. No behavior change.
Patch updates of Rust dependencies for ICU text internationalization data, zerovec, yoke, tinystr and erased-serde. Clippy and all tests pass.

Security: the zip archive library moves from 8.6.0 to 9.0.0, fixing three advisories (RUSTSEC-2026-0367/0368/0369) about unsafe extraction of ZIP entries. The app does not call extract(), so the exposure was not reachable here. Office package code now treats entry names that are not valid UTF-8 as errors instead of reading them lossily.
Removes three stray backup copies of test files (*.rs-E) that were committed by mistake. They were not compiled or referenced, so no behavior changes.
README now lists all eleven registered workflows (it said nine and left out concrete documents and publish status).
The HTTP client ureq moves from 3.4.2 to 3.5.0, which includes TLS security fixes. Proxy URLs with a literal percent sign in their credentials must now escape it as %25.
Patch updates of the Rust dependencies, including Tauri 2.12.5 and Tokio 1.54.1. Clippy with warnings denied and all 542 plus 14 Rust tests pass.
The test runner vitest moves from 4.1.11 to 5.0.5. All 263 frontend tests, the production build, and the test config pass with no deprecation warnings.
The test browser environment jsdom moves from 30.0.1 to 30.1.3. All 263 frontend tests and the production build pass.
The Node type definitions move from 26.2.0 to 26.6.5. Typecheck, tests, and the production build pass.
The icon library lucide-react moves from 1.32.0 to 1.62.0. Typecheck, tests, and the production build pass; every imported icon still exists.
React and React DOM move from 19.2.8 to 19.3.1. Typecheck, tests, and the production build pass with no new warnings.
Build tooling: the Tauri CLI moves to 2.12.4, a patch release of the version already in use.
The quality workflow no longer keeps the repository access token in the checkout after fetching the source.
Correction to the 1.35.18 notes: the late-restore change is a defensive fix, not a confirmed cause of the intermittent shortcut test failure.
The release gate no longer runs cargo check, which clippy with all targets already covers. The gate is about 5 seconds faster.
Internal cleanup: three retired replica and Outlook functions that were kept behind allow(dead_code) are removed. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: the size-limit and decoding checks for workbook XML attributes are one helper. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: three manual-review rows in the Follow Up classifier are built by one helper. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: the print-settings columns for file and worksheet print rows are set by one shared helper. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: the two workbook package writers share one entry-copy loop. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: three copies of the HTTP error mapping are one shared conversion. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: the Outlook reply preview is one shared component instead of two copies. No behavior change.
Internal cleanup: the file-selection merge used by drag-and-drop and Add Files is one shared helper. No behavior change.

Accessibility, error handling, and wording improvements since 1.35.0: screen-reader announcements, keyboard focus in dialogs, readable contrast, a crash-safe error screen, and local-language messages.
The English search placeholder uses the same ellipsis character as the rest of the app.
Four capitalized English Exact words in Turkish Follow Up messages now say Tam, and one garbled phrase is fixed.
Turkish signed-scan and related forms use tam, inceleme, Uyarı, and RFI spelling instead of the English words exact, Review, and Warning.
Two Turkish labels in the PDF rotation form use the local wording: inceleme folder and job completion.
The word sync in Turkish and Azerbaijani settings and automation messages is replaced with the local words for synchronization.
Leftover English words in Turkish, Azerbaijani, and Russian operation descriptions now use the local name of the operation.
A file or value picked before the remembered settings finish loading is no longer overwritten by those settings.
Internal test change: the keyboard shortcut test waits longer for the preview. No change to the app.
If the web client for sign-in or Gemini cannot be created at startup, the app reports an error instead of crashing.
An unexpected screen error shows a message and a reload button instead of a blank window.
Filter tabs and category chips announce whether they are selected to screen readers.
Dialogs take keyboard focus when they open, keep Tab inside, and return focus to the control that opened them.
Error and warning messages are announced by screen readers when they appear. A flaky keyboard shortcut test has more time to finish.
The page language now follows the selected interface language, so screen readers pronounce Turkish, Russian, and Azerbaijani text correctly.
Text fields, selects, and the table search box have a darker border that meets the 3 to 1 contrast minimum in light and dark themes.
The table search box shows the same keyboard focus outline as other inputs.
Eleven more backend error messages (RFI file groups and source files, diagnostics files, generated files, print queue identifiers) now show translated text.
Twenty-five more backend error messages (diagnostics, clipboard, RFI folders, RFI documents and PDFs, created folders, and AI extraction) now show translated text.
Fourteen more backend error messages (review locations, print file and queue folders, saved print jobs, preset values, scan destinations, and deletion) now show translated text.
Thirteen more backend error messages (print queue, saved print jobs, file selection, file reveal, preview, undo, scan and review reads) now show translated text.
Eleven more backend error messages now show in Turkish, English, Russian, and Azerbaijani instead of raw English text.
Touch targets meet the 24 by 24 px minimum on phone width: the operation search box, the on-off switches, and the font-size slider were smaller.
Light-theme muted text is darker, so category chips and small grey labels meet the 4.5:1 contrast minimum. Measured on every screen in light and dark.
When remembered settings fail to save, the operation screen shows a message instead of failing silently. The message clears after the next successful save.

Bounded number fields show their allowed range under the input, for print copies, retries, timeout, and concrete document ambient temperatures. Minor release: the Windows installer workflow runs for this tag.
Fixes a Windows-only test failure that stopped the 1.34.0 installer build. Two lexical path tests now use the platform's absolute temp directory instead of a Unix-style path.
Ambient temperature fields for concrete documents carry the backend bounds of 0 to 100 °C, so the form rejects out-of-range values before preview. Print bounds share one helper.
Plan table row selection (select all, group select, toggle, and pruning of removed rows) moved into usePlanSelection, with tests. No behavior change.
Saved-settings restore and autosave for operation screens moved into useSavedParams, with tests for restore, preset handling, and debounced save. No behavior change.
Keyboard shortcuts for operation screens (Ctrl or Cmd+Enter to preview or apply, Escape to step back) moved into their own hook with tests. No behavior change.
First minor release with the Windows installer workflow. Print copies, retries, and timeout fields now carry their backend bounds, so the form rejects out-of-range values before preview.
Turkish labels use Sayfa instead of the English word Sheet for sheet selection and the follow-up sheet column. Workbook column headers such as Inspection Status stay as they are.
The browser-only demo bridge and its demo data are removed from the desktop build. Main bundle drops from 345.6 kB to 316.0 kB (gzip 102.0 kB to 94.6 kB).
